findings: Included certificates and data-use agreement state 880 normal, 1477 bacterial and 900 viral images, consistent with 3257 metadata rows and inspected file counts.
Metadata has Filename, Age, Gender and Class columns, without missing values; no patient identifier column is provided.
Included agreement names the hospital and a specific university research lab as parties, limits access to authorized research personnel, and restricts raw-image redistribution.
Public Figshare listing indicates CC BY 4.0, whereas this mirror lists license Unknown; the scope of the release has not been independently resolved.
decision: No external model predictions. Seek source clarification before treating this mirror as an authorized external research cohort.
limitations: This inspects supplied documents, not authenticity, authority or legal applicability.
A certificate describing patient counts is not individual-level patient-identity verification.
No agreement was signed or accepted; no patient re-identification was attempted.
